basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old guy living in Mayport, Florida. I'm relatively new to Reddit but enjoying the diverse communities here. By day, I work as a freelance web developer, which gives me the flexibility to travel and meet new people. I'm currently single and open to various types of relationships. My interests include exploring new technologies, participating in online discussions about social issues like gun control, and occasionally diving into gaming. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, often after 7 PM, when I have some downtime.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a focus on web development, primarily self-taught through online courses and community forums. My interest in technology extends to understanding new digital currencies, hence my occasional visits to subreddits like HuhToken.
